consumer: A dialogue/condition eligibility check (the u_has_item/npc_has_item DEEP_TALK lambda) asking 'does this character actor have item X on their person right now'
scope: on-person possession of the character actor (held/worn inventory plus charges), as a u_has_item/npc_has_item dialogue predicate computes it
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item builds the lambda returning actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1) over d.alpha/d.beta
divergence: Item X sitting in an adjacent reachable container or tile but not on the avatar's person: a find-item-objective over reachable inventory would count it, but u_has_item returns false — exposing scope only if the goal needed broader reach, which here it does not
